SELECT pe.*, pc.nombre AS category_name
FROM payroll_employees pe
LEFT JOIN payroll_employments pem ON pem.employee_id = pe.id AND pem.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN payroll_categories pc ON pem.category_id = pc.id
WHERE ($1::integer IS NULL OR pe.clinic_id = $1::integer)
  AND ($2::boolean IS NULL OR pe.activo = $2::boolean)
ORDER BY pe.apellidos, pe.nombres

SELECT pe.*, pc.nombre AS category_name
FROM payroll_employees pe
LEFT JOIN payroll_employments pem ON pem.employee_id = pe.id AND pem.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN payroll_categories pc ON pem.category_id = pc.id
WHERE pe.id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO payroll_employees
  (id, clinic_id, cedula, nombres, apellidos, fecha_nacimiento, sexo, estado_civil,
   domicilio, telefono, email, banco, cuenta_banco, numero_bps, fecha_ingreso, foto_url, activo, user_id)
VALUES
  (COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
   $2::integer,
   $3, $4, $5,
   NULLIF($6,'')::date,
   NULLIF($7,''),
   NULLIF($8,''),
   NULLIF($9,''), NULLIF($10,''), NULLIF($11,''),
   NULLIF($12,''), NULLIF($13,''), NULLIF($14,''),
   $15::date,
   NULLIF($16,''),
   $17::boolean,

  fecha_ingreso   = EXCLUDED.fecha_ingreso,

INSERT INTO payroll_employments
  (id, employee_id, clinic_id, tipo_contrato, category_id, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin,
   jornada_horas_semanales, modalidad_jornada, sueldo_base,
   productividad_porcentaje, productividad_base, tipo_aporte_bps, is_active)
VALUES
  (COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
   $2::uuid, $3::integer,
   $4::contract_type_enum,
   NULLIF($5,'')::uuid,
   $6::date, NULLIF($7,'')::date,
   $8::decimal, $9::modalidad_jornada_enum,
   $10::decimal, $11::decimal,
   $12::percentage_basis_enum,

   $14::boolean)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  tipo_contrato            = EXCLUDED.tipo_contrato,
  category_id              = EXCLUDED.category_id,
  fecha_inicio             = EXCLUDED.fecha_inicio,

  sueldo_base              = EXCLUDED.sueldo_base,

  productividad_base       = EXCLUDED.productividad_base,

SELECT dc.*, u.name AS doctor_name
FROM payroll_contracts dc
LEFT JOIN users u ON dc.user_id = u.id
WHERE dc.user_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY dc.valid_from DESC

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.identity_document, u.is_active,
       STRING_AGG(r.name, '--') AS roles
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
WHERE u.is_active = true
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY u.name

INSERT INTO payroll_egresos (employee_id, employment_id, fecha_egreso, motivo, salario_pendiente, aguinaldo_proporcional, licencia_no_gozada, salario_vacacional, indemnizacion, total, created_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $1::uuid, $2::date, $3, $4::numeric, $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7::numeric, $8::numeric, $9::numeric, NOW())
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING *

SELECT sc.id, sc.fecha_sesion AS start_at, a.end_datetime AS end_at,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(CASE WHEN a.start_datetime IS NOT NULL AND a.end_datetime IS NOT NULL
      THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_datetime - a.start_datetime))/60)::int ELSE 0 END, 0),
    NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(svc.duration_minutes),0)::int FROM tratamientos_sesion ts
            JOIN service_catalog svc ON svc.id = ts.service_catalog_id WHERE ts.sesion_id = sc.id), 0),
    NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(svc2.duration_minutes),0)::int FROM appointment_service_catalog asc2
            JOIN service_catalog svc2 ON svc2.id = asc2.service_id WHERE asc2.appointment_id = sc.appointment_id), 0),
    0
  ) AS duration_min,
  sc.procedimiento_realizado, sc.diagnostico, sc.notas_clinicas,
  p.name AS paciente_name, sc.appointment_id, sc.quote_id, sc.invoice_id
FROM sesiones_clinicas sc
LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.id = sc.appointment_id
LEFT JOIN users p ON p.id = sc.paciente_id
WHERE sc.doctor_id = $1::uuid
  AND ($2::date IS NULL OR sc.fecha_sesion >= $2::date)
  AND ($3::date IS NULL OR sc.fecha_sesion < ($3::date + INTERVAL '1 day'))
ORDER BY sc.fecha_sesion DESC
